purpose: Prevent a Rider x Circumference model from being fit on venue-level contrasts or a handful of repeated-rider anecdotes. This gate must pass from PRE identity/membership only before the exact predictive formula can be frozen and any development RESULT may be joined.
cross_circumference_supported_rider_defi: One official registration number with at least one valid, point-in-time PRE race at a verified 333/333.33m venue and at least one valid PRE race at a verified 400m venue in the development acquisition pool. RESULT is irrelevant to this definition.
why_30: Thirty cross-circumference riders is a conservative identifiability floor for a shrinkage-based rider-specific interaction: it prevents the scientific claim from resting on the currently known single-digit repeated-rider set and provides multiple independent rider units for later uncertainty and concentration diagnostics. It is a support floor, not a power guarantee.

current_known_support.note: Nara final PRE card is still pending, so 9 is a scheduled-support upper input, not final usable support.

gate_evaluation_timing: Evaluate only after PRE-only acquisition/identity tables for the intended development pool are frozen. Do not inspect any target RESULT to decide whether to add blocks or change thresholds.
if_gate_passes: Freeze the exact low-DOF predictive formula, shrinkage/parameter rule, development membership, primary metric, race-cluster bootstrap, and advance/no-advance criterion before any RESULT join.
if_gate_fails: RESULT remains closed. Add future whole-day PRE blocks in chronological source order under a separately written pre-event acquisition extension. Never lower the threshold because outcomes are attractive or because acquisition is inconvenient.
unsupported_rider_policy: No rider-specific affinity value is silently encoded as zero. Formula design remains blocked until it explicitly defines how unsupported riders are handled and that handling is frozen before RESULT.
